cohort: The study included 165 neonatal deaths enrolled in the CHAMPS-Kenya site between 2017 and 2021, whose causes of death were determined by a panel of experts.
finding: Twenty-six percent (43/165) of neonatal deaths at the CHAMPS-Kenya site between 2017 and 2021 were attributable to Respiratory Distress Syndrome, mostly occurring in low birthweight and preterm neonates with suboptimal diagnosis and management.
